ns2:course.label: Design Workshop Studio I
ns2:course.description: Project design at various scales utilizing problems of a wide range of complexity and subject matter; rural, community, and urban problems, housing, recreation, and natural areas; emphasizes problem analysis and generation of innovative design alternatives. Students select from several sections depending on specific interests. Prerequisite: LA 335 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: LA 335 or consent of instructor.
